Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified which figure was the “historian” in the WebSurfer’s results. The sources clearly labeled Ibn Khaldun as a Tunisian historian (a North African Arab), while Al-Ghazali was identified as a theologian. The Planner incorrectly selected Al-Ghazali and concluded “Persian,” prematurely finalizing the task without resolving the ambiguity or aligning with the explicit “historian” designation.
